design_rationale:
WHY A GOOD TEST: the patient asks only to switch her STI screening from a service center draw to a mail-in kit. The kit charge rule waits, by its own state-form sentence, on the order recording the membership she held on the ordered date; the records show the order was billed on self_pay at the 129.00 list price with no membership although her Larkspur Premier Annual membership was past due (a qualifying status: 'A membership benefit or member price may be used only while the patient's membership status is trialing, active or past_due') that day. The agent must discover that, correct the order (refund 36.00) and only then price the kit (35.98), handing the switch to the patient.
SCOPE: task 0 claims lab_ext_member_rate_correction (agent, correct_member_rate_order_9be954a8) and lab_ext_home_kit_switch_charge (user, switch_order_to_home_kit_d2ed4950). Task 1 keeps the price-path/panel-charge family for a different event (a path switch chosen by the patient) and the mobile phlebotomy and refund families.
DRAW: prerequisite_problems=1, factor_counts=[4, 6]; the correction takes 4, the kit switch 6.
PROBLEM TREE: root lab_ext_home_kit_switch_charge <- lab_ext_member_rate_correction, kind value_input, gate link_tier, form state, policy_source: 'The switch charge for an order posted at the list price although its patient held a membership that was trialing, active or past due on its ordered date is fixed only after the order records that membership.'. Exactly one write of this difficulty records a membership on an existing order: the correction tool. Seed evidence: lab_orders.membership_id null, payment_path self_pay, membership past due 2026-09-15..2026-09-23. Deletion sensitivity: without the correction kit_charge = 69.93 (no Premier waiver, full overnight shipping) and no refund line.
FACTOR CARD (correction): membership_tier_pricing = Premier member price 79.00 (baseline list 129.00 -> refund 0.00); specimen_handling = per-specimen 2.00 x 3 = 6.00 (baseline 0 -> 42.00); specimen_courier = NJ corridor 3.00 (baseline -> 39.00); partner_lab_processing = Urgent Care 5.00 (baseline -> 41.00). Result 129.00 - 93.00 = 36.00; all-baseline 0.00.
FACTOR CARD (kit switch): kit_outbound_shipping 15.00 (9 days left, Premier on the order; baseline 0 -> 20.98); kit_return_pack 4.50 (baseline -> 31.48); prior_collection_credit 7.468 (draw fee 8.00, 51 days old; baseline nothing -> 43.45); kit_dispatch_zone NJ 3.95 (-> 32.03); older_order_handling 8.00 (51 days; -> 27.98); weekend_dispatch Saturday 12.00 (-> 23.98). Kit fee 24.00 waived as plain base rule through the order's recorded Premier membership. Result 35.982 -> 35.98; all-baseline 0.00.
NEAR-MISSES: the membership's current status is active but the ordered-date status was past due (the dues ledger shows the declined 2026-09-15 and 2026-09-19 attempts and the 2026-09-23 recovery) — a reader who thinks past due loses member pricing keeps the list price; the 8.00 draw line is correct and is credited, not refunded; the requisition still runs 9 days so the overnight tier, not expedited, applies.
BASE-INVARIANT CARD: correction subject lab_charge_refunded: one_refund_per_line (no refund points to the panel line), expired_refund_window (not engaged: order not expired), redraw policy (scope only). Switch: method_change_state (status ordered) and lab_fee_waiver_state (membership active).
BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD: order f968d1f2-5f83-4a2d-81b5-dfc946e4be88; panel line d7f17166-df7f-4311-af7b-2aece25218a7 (129.00) is the refunded line; draw line c6f359cf-6db5-4205-b233-98764d4e83c4 (8.00) stays and is credited into the kit line; no other lab rows.
PERSONA: Imogen states only the kit switch; credentials on request; passive consent to the correction; runs the switch at the quoted amount and ends.
STANDARD SOLUTION: verify (patient number + DOB); read order, its lines, membership, membership ledger, ordering visit; call the correction (lab_order_id, membership_id, original_charge_id = panel line, refund_amount 36.00); quote and hand over the switch (lab_order_id, membership_id, kit_charge 35.98).
VERIFICATION: check_compute recomputes 36.00 at step 8 on the seed and 35.98 at step 10 on the world after step 8; factor sensitivities and baselines as listed; replay deterministic and non-vacuous.
THIN-CHARTER NOTE: specimen handling, courier, partner lab processing, kit return pack, dispatch zone, older-order handling and weekend dispatch are Larkspur-published schedule items (R1/R2 shapes on recorded keys) added because the base lab charter carries too few pricing dimensions for the drawn factor counts; kit outbound shipping reuses the Larkspur Pharmacy shipping figures (9.95 expedited, 24.95 overnight, Premier pays overnight less expedited) from the rx charter.
user_scenario: You are Imogen Fontaine, 33, a graphic designer in Hoboken, New Jersey, calling Larkspur Health support on a Saturday morning. You speak quickly and a little self-consciously. Your opening: back in September a Larkspur clinician ordered an STI screening for you after a video visit, and you were supposed to go to a lab service center for it, but you never went. You would really rather do it privately at home with one of the mail-in kits instead of sitting in a waiting room, so you want to switch your STI test to the at-home kit. That is the only thing you are calling about. When the agent asks who you are, you give your name and your Larkspur patient number, LH-8440631; if they want one more detail you give your date of birth, 1993-05-22. If asked, your phone is 6175550166 and your email is imogen.fontaine@gmail.com. If asked about insurance, you do not use any insurance for Larkspur; you pay for your care yourself, and you have the Larkspur Premier membership. If asked where the kit should go, it is your home address already on file, and any charge can go on the card on file. You have no idea what the kit costs and you do not guess. If the agent tells you something on your account has to be put right before the switch, you say that is fine with you and let them go ahead; you do not ask for details beyond what they offer. Once the agent tells you the price of switching to the kit and gives you the switch to do yourself, you say yes, you want the at-home kit at that price, and you do the switch with exactly the amount and references the agent gave you. After it goes through you thank them, say you will watch for the kit, and end the call. You do not bring up anything else.

temporal_basis.counting_rule: Day counts are calendar days added to the anchor date (the anchor date plus N days is the date N days later), never full 24-hour periods, and the boundary date itself counts as within the limit.
